summary: Complete independent canonical audit of all 238 Chinese units, 201 temporal or active-hint items, and 58 people. The dated Northern Qi events, age statements, and explicitly classified posthumous appointments were read against the Chinese; however, seven repair groups remain. They include false point precision for 初 and 中, invented dynasty-era or narrative life ranges, and retrospective/literary allusions converted into personal activity. The chapter is therefore needs-revision, not approved.
